Definition: from G1909 and G154; to ask for:--beg.
BiblicalUsage: To beg. The unjust steward says, I cannot dig, to beg I am ashamed, in Luke 16:3, and the blind man sat by the wayside begging as Jesus passed near Jericho in Luke 18:35.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe begging is the honest posture of us all before God — the steward was too proud for it, and the blind man was not, and only one of them went home seeing.
